facts.quote: As our business continues to grow and evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can.
We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers.
Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement.

parsed.subject: Collaborating on an Instagram Post Idea
parsed.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We're reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on your recent campaign around the Direct Trade model. You mentioned that Stumptown Coffee Roasters has a commitment to honoring their Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for their coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to their producers. This post would highlight that dedication and the impact it has on the coffee-making process, showcasing the value of your partnership with Stumptown. It would also invite your team to share a moment of connection with your customers, further deepening their experience at your cafes. The post would focus on the emotional aspect of the partnership, emphasizing the value of the relationships and the commitment to quality. It would be a way to reinforce your dedication to the Direct Trade model and the positive impact it has on the industry.

The BrandPilot team.
